audio.quiet_preview.claim: Untested after the required wake sequence; the pre-wake volume query returned an empty payload before playback.

battery.state_voltage.claim: Firmware battery state and voltage queries succeeded repeatedly, including after wake.

ble.connect_disconnect.claim: Five fresh cycles and a 30-minute stationary session completed with clean disconnects.

collision.configuration.claim: The pinned adapter advertises collision configuration; the actual firmware behavior has not been exercised.

drive.bounded_calibration.claim: On 8-inch carpet tiles, stock/default-primary heading pulses at speed 25 for 0.10 s produced observed forward locomotion; measured displacement was 0.0762 m in one run.

emergency_stop.physical.claim: One carpet-tile moving pulse ended stationary inside the marked 0.25 m lane after the independent OFF/0 watchdog; other surfaces remain unverified.

head.position_read.claim: After documented wake, neutral-state, and passive-stream setup, the R201 returned a read-only head position and disconnected safe-held.

led.dome_logic_display.claim: The bounded dome LED sequence completed after wake and was physically observed.

stop.command_acknowledgement.claim: The final OFF/0 safe-hold command received a response after wake; physical stopping effectiveness was not measured.

stop.physical_effectiveness.claim: On 8-inch carpet tiles, one watchdog-stopped run ended at 0.06985 m from start, inside the 0.25 m containment lane; braking distance is not separately measured.

telemetry.stationary.claim: Session initialization enabled accelerometer, attitude, gyroscope, locator, and velocity streams on the R201; sample delivery remains a separate measurement.

wake.stance_cycle.claim: Wake was acknowledged and physically observed cycling three-leg to two-leg stance without locomotion.
